description: This file defines the 'Action' class within the OpenCart framework, responsible for representing an executable action or controller route. It provides mechanisms to initialize an action with a route, retrieve its ID, and execute the action by invoking the associated controller and method within the framework.

classes.name: Action
classes.description: Represents a stored action that can be executed within the OpenCart framework, encapsulating the route, controller, and method to invoke.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Action object with a route, sanitizing the route string and determining the controller and method names.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the route string identifying the action.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes the action by loading the appropriate controller via the registry and calling the specified method with arguments.
